cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：艰难的；强硬的
cards.example_en: The last science problem was tough for everyone.
cards.example_zh: 最后一道科学题大家都觉得很难。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: She wants to go to university.

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：厢式货车
cards.example_en: The van stopped outside the school.
cards.example_zh: 厢式货车停在学校外面。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：船；容器
cards.example_en: The vessel left the port at noon.
cards.example_zh: 那艘船中午离开了港口。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: Old farmers predict a storm when the swallows fly low.
cards.example_zh: 燕子低飞时，老农便能预测暴风雨将至。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：参考；查阅
cards.example_en: Always refer to the map if you miss the turning.
cards.example_zh: 如果错过路口，一定要查阅地图。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：表格；形式
cards.example_en: New students complete a form on their first morning.
cards.example_zh: 新生在开学第一个早晨填写一张表格。

cards.example_en: Remove the broken chair from the classroom aisle.
cards.example_zh: 把那把坏椅子从教室过道里搬走。

cards.example_en: Our town uses river transport to bring rice to the market.
cards.example_zh: 我们镇用河道运输把大米送到市场。

cards.example_en: The smell of Mum's cooking pulled us into the kitchen at once.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈烹饪的香味一下子把我们吸引进了厨房。

cards.example_en: Silent reading starts as soon as we take our seats.
cards.example_zh: 我们一坐好，就开始安静阅读。

cards.example_en: Holiday spending left almost nothing in my purse.
cards.example_zh: 假期的开支几乎把我钱包里的钱花光了。

cards.example_en: I added one carrot, my favorite vegetable, to the soup.
cards.example_zh: 我往汤里加了一根胡萝卜，那是我最喜欢的蔬菜。

cards.example_en: Our career adviser suggested a summer job at the library.
cards.example_zh: 职业顾问建议我暑假到图书馆去打工。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：背包旅行者
cards.example_en: A tired backpacker asked us how to reach the hostel.
cards.example_zh: 一位疲惫的背包客问我们青年旅社该怎么走。
